source.track: Open textbook · university-level educational psychology / teacher education · self-paced

note: Units follow the book's twelve chapters in teaching order, paired two chapters per unit: the profession and the learning process, development and diversity, special educational needs and motivation, classroom management and communication, complex thinking and planning, and the two assessment chapters. Early chapters map to the foundational lessons, classroom practice chapters to the intermediate lessons, and assessment to the advanced lesson.
